description: The places this account's memory is organised into: its own projects (anything written under project:<slug>:*, newest activity first), the workspaces other people have granted it (enter one with switch_workspace(name=<grantor>)), and, for a sharer, who they invited and whether each person accepted and entered yet (shared_by_you). Shows which workspace this session is in, if any. Use it when a person's request is about one project, or asks who has access, or whether an invitee came in.
name: list_workspaces
title: List Workspaces
